title: A school payroll sample understated earnings reported to a pension plan

beats.text: In fiscal 2017 San Francisco schools could not provide all their pension reporting records.

visual.sub: Incomplete earnings documentation led to alternate checks

beats.text: Alternative audit checks found the overall employer contributions were fairly stated.

visual.line: The overall employer contributions were fairly stated.

beats.text: The next audit closed the recommendation. In 2019, another test found an error.

visual.kicker: The first review closed before a later sample failed

beats.text: One of 45 items understated earnings reported to a pension plan.
The auditors did not identify the plan or give a dollar amount.

visual.kicker: The first review closed before a later sample failed

beats.text: The city retirement system published its own districtwide cash figures.

visual.kicker: One pension plan’s districtwide contribution was paid in full

beats.text: For 2019 the amount required and the amount paid were equal.
That total tells us what the district paid on the reported payroll.

visual.kicker: One pension plan’s districtwide contribution was paid in full

beats.text: It cannot tell us which plan or which earnings were affected.

visual.kicker: One pension plan’s districtwide contribution was paid in full

beats.text: The fiscal 2020 audit marked the recommendation resolved.

visual.kicker: The next district audit marked the exception resolved

beats.text: It did not give a correction amount or identify an individual benefit change.

visual.kicker: The next district audit marked the exception resolved

beats.text: A redacted correction would show what ultimately changed.
